summary: This study tested how weekly injections of a drug called semaglutide affect energy use and metabolism in people with obesity. Researchers looked at body energy, physical activity, and weight changes over a 24-week period. The trial involved 60 participants who received either the study drug or a placebo, which looks like the drug but has no active medicine. The trial has now been completed.
